title: SLeeLa LLM model-capacity profile (version 1.0)
description: A declarative, USER-OWNED description of the model the caller intends to run, within a supported envelope of ~2 GB to 16 GB of weights. SLeeLa ships no weights and selects no model; this records the user's choice so the reasoning layer can scale its budget. The envelope bounds are advisory.

model_id.description: The caller's identifier for THEIR model. Not a model shipped by SLeeLa.

weight_bytes.description: Declared weight size in bytes. The supported envelope is 2 GiB (2147483648) to 16 GiB (17179869184); values outside are accepted with an advisory warning.

tier_hint.description: Optional; the native layer derives the tier from weight_bytes. If present it should agree with that derivation.

context_tokens.description: 0 => derive from tier. A nonzero value overrides the tier default.

ram_budget_bytes.description: Host memory the user allots; 0 => unspecified.

accelerated.description: True if a GPU/accelerator backend is used.
